title: Prefetch Orchestrator: Field Lab for batching/caching/quantization experiments
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create and track a lightweight field lab (Prefetch Orchestrator) to run controlled experiments across batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization profiles. Purpose: produce reproducible unit-econ deltas, safe rollouts for high-variance workloads, and playbooks for automatic profile selection in the runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment registry UI populated with initial 12 experiments and metadata (workload tags, expected econ impact)
End-to-end pipeline exists: candidate config -> canary run -> metrics collection -> automated analysis notebook
Safety gates implemented: canary rollback trigger, perf degradation alert, and quality regression threshold (measured on golden prompts)
Runbook and rollout checklist authored and reviewed by SRE and Security (KMS/HSM implications documented)
experiment_matrix: E1: Small-batch vs dynamic-batch (latency SLO 150ms) across r3 model family — measure tokens/sec and p50/p95 latency
E2: Prefix-KV cache TTL 30s vs 5m vs session-persistent on chat workloads — measure hit rate and token reductions
E3: 8-bit quant profile A vs profile B on LLM-7B variant — measure output quality delta (BLEU-like proxies) and cost delta
E4: Combined: dynamic batching + prefix cache + quant profile B, stress test for tail latency and % of requests degraded
decisions: Use weighted-random rollout for initial 10% traffic canary to balance exposure and data collection (decision 2025-02-20)
Default golden prompt set will be the cross-product of chat/completion/short/long anchor prompts used by Console QA (decision 2025-02-25)
Quant profiles will be evaluated using surrogate metrics (embedding drift + token perplexity proxies) before human eval to reduce cost (decision 2025-02-28)

next_steps: Finish PR for registry backend (GH #278) and link to experimentation CI (owner: Arun, due 2025-03-07)
Run E1 canary on staging for 48h, collect latency and token-cost signals (owner: Eng - inference team)
Complete security checklist and KMS/HSM design doc for persistent cache keys (owner: Security, due 2025-03-10)
Coordinate human-eval of top 3 quant candidates with Research (owner: Maya Chen)
metrics: Unit econ delta (cost per 1k generated tokens) — target: >= 8% reduction for priority workloads
Quality regression rate on golden prompts — target: <1.5% regression for any experiment
Cache hit rate improvement and resulting token savings — target: >=12% token reduction for chat flows
Tail latency (p99) increase — target: <= 20ms increase relative to baseline
notes: Trade-offs discussed: aggressive caching can reduce cost but increases stale-state risk for streaming chat — mitigation: session affinity TTL + explicit invalidation APIs.
Design requested a compact diff view in the registry so PMs can quickly compare econ vs quality — filed DES-431 as follow-up.
SRE emphasized observability hooks: per-experiment tracing tags and token-level cost attribution to enable causal analysis.
Potential follow-ups: automated model-selection rules in the router that pick quantized variant when token-econ target met for a customer tier.
